mistakes.text: She sprints at full speed since the gun went off.
mistakes.normalized: she sprints at full speed since the gun went off
mistakes.feedback_sk: Dej, ktorý začal v minulosti a trvá dodnes, vyjadruje Present Perfect Continuous: „has been sprinting“, nie „sprints“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Děj, který začal v minulosti a trvá dodnes, vyjadřuje Present Perfect Continuous: „has been sprinting“, ne „sprints“.
mistakes.feedback_en: An action that started in the past and is still going on needs Present Perfect Continuous: “has been sprinting”, not “sprints”.

mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „since“ je jednorazový dej v minulosti, preto Past Simple: „since she started“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „since“ je jednorázový děj v minulosti, proto Past Simple: „since she started“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “since”, the starting event is a finished past moment, so use Past Simple: “since she started”.
